messages.content: What versions of Infrana Alert are being used by "delta"?

function.name: create_website_alert_config
function.description: This API endpoint creates a new Website Alert Configuration, associating alert parameters with a specific website based on given criteria such as severity, rules, and thresholds. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

name.description: The name for the website alert configuration.

description.description: A detailed description for the website alert configuration.

severity.description: The severity level of the alert when triggered, represented by a numerical value. Common values are 5 for 'Critical', and 10 for 'High'.

triggering.description: A flag indicating whether an incident should also be triggered when the alert is activated.

websiteId.description: The unique identifier of the website to which this alert configuration will apply.

tagFilterExpression.description: A boolean expression of tag filters defining the scope of relevant website beacons.

granularity.description: The evaluation granularity in minutes, used for detecting threshold violations within a tumbling time window.

rule.description: The type of rule associated with this alert configuration. Expected to be a string that represents the rule name, such as 'response_time' or 'error_rate'.

threshold.description: The numerical value that, when exceeded, triggers the alert. This is a float type value.

timeThreshold.description: The time duration in minutes over which the threshold is evaluated for violations.

alertChannelIds.description: A list of IDs corresponding to alert channels defined within the system. Each ID should be a string that uniquely identifies an alert channel.

function.name: create_infra_alert_config
function.description: Creates a new infrastructure alert configuration for monitoring system health and performance. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

name.description: The name of the alert configuration.

threshold.description: The threshold value that triggers the alert. This is a float type value.

enabled.description: Whether the alert is enabled or disabled.

alert_type.description: The type of alert to create.

duration.description: The duration in minutes for which the threshold must be exceeded before an alert is triggered.

function.name: find_infra_alert_config_versions
function.description: Retrieves a list of all versions of an infrastructure alert configuration based on the provided ID, including those that have been deleted. The configurations are returned in descending order by their creation date. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

id.description: The unique identifier of the infrastructure alert configuration.

message.content:
I’m happy to help! To retrieve the version history you’ll need the **ID** of the infrastructure‑alert configuration that “delta” is using. Could you let me know:

1. The exact name or ID of the infra‑alert config tied to “delta”, or  
2. Any other identifying detail (e.g., its purpose—CPU monitor, memory check, etc.)  

Once I have that information, I can fetch the full list of versions for you.
